content.short: Manta Network is a modular ZK ecosystem featuring Manta Pacific (L2 on Ethereum) and Manta Atlantic (L1).
content.description:
Manta Network is a leading modular ecosystem designed for the next generation of Zero-Knowledge (ZK) applications. It consists of two primary networks: Manta Pacific, a modular Layer 2 on Ethereum that uses Celestia for data availability, and Manta Atlantic, a high-speed ZK-focused Layer 1 on Polkadot. This dual structure allows developers to deploy ZK-enabled dApps with high throughput and significantly lower gas fees compared to traditional environments.

By leveraging advanced ZK-proofs, Manta Network provides a secure and privacy-preserving framework for DeFi, gaming, and identity applications. The protocol focuses on modularity and interoperability, enabling a seamless experience for both developers and users across multiple ecosystems. As a core infrastructure component for the ZK revolution, Manta Network is empowering builders to create scalable and secure applications that prioritize user sovereignty and data integrity in the decentralized economy.
content.meta: Manta Network provides modular ZK-enabled Layer 1 and Layer 2 infrastructure for scalable decentralized applications.
